rationale.en: The labeled example illustrates a subtype declaration with registration/sequence-library macros and superclass construction. It introduces no independent API beyond the surrounding declaration/constructor and macro clauses. The related original fixture observes typed inheritance without copying the example or claiming every static-registration behavior.
